thread:
Priya S.: Quick flag for partners: we're cutting a breaking change for the SDK/protocol. v3 'batch' call changes shape in v4 — payload now expects an 'entries' array of {input, ctx} and a top-level 'trace_id' instead of the older 'inputs' + 'batch_token'. We need a partner rollout playbook (embargo windows, compat options, and marketplace gating).
Mike L.: Understood. What lead time do partners need? we should separate marketplace validation time from SI/customers.
Anya K.: Marketplace reviewers need ~8 weeks to run integration tests and security scans. SI teams usually ask for 6+ weeks to update end-customer integrations.
Priya S.: Proposed cadence: announce preview to partners -> two-week preview with opt-in feature flag -> six-week migration window with compat layer available -> announce public GA and 60-day formal sunset for v3 traffic.
Jordan T.: Concern: some hardware partners ship a batching shim on device that relies on the old flat inputs array. That requires firmware/driver retests which can take longer. Suggest two parallel mitigations: short-term server-side compat rewrite AND a partner-specific extension for hardware testers.
Eli R.: Ops can expose a /compat/v3 endpoint that rewrites entries to the new shape. We can rate limit and quota it to avoid long-term costs. Ops estimates 3 engineers for two weeks to build and 90 days safe run window before infra costs spike.
Anya K.: For partner communications I'll prepare: 1) migration one-pager, 2) sample diffs + migration script, 3) SDK helper snippet (Client.migrate_batch(inputs) and Client.from_legacy_payload). Need owners for each.
Mike L.: I'll own the SDK helper and a sample PR for python/js SDKs. Also adding a convenience builder: Client.batch_from_entries([...]) that wraps the new format.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: breaking-schema changes require a compatibility badge and an automated integration test matrix uploaded to the vendor console before GA. See https://marketplace.redwood.ai/guides/compatibility for details.
Jordan T.: Hardware team: I'll produce a retest checklist for vendor drivers and a mapping doc for old->new semantics (e.g., batch_token -> trace_id). ETA in timeline below.
Priya S.: Legal and PR: we need embargo language for joint announcements, and clear timeline for partners who want co-marketing. @legal-team can you advise on wording and any non-disclosure constraints?
legal-team: We'll need a short embargo clause template. We'll review once you share the partner list and dates. Prefer to have final wording 10 business days before public GA.
Anya K.: Suggested partner options: 1) Self-migrate (free), 2) Assisted migration (paid, 90-day extended compat), 3) Full migration service (priority retest + co-marketing).
Eli R.: Ops note: we'll publish an explicit sunset date in the partner dashboard and expose a metric showing percent of traffic hitting /compat endpoint so partners can track migration progress.
Priya S.: Action items and owners (add to partner tracker):
- Anya: partner playbook + one-pager + email templates (due 1736659200)
- Mike: SDK helper + sample PRs (py/js) + migration snippet (due 1736426400)
- Eli: design + runbook for /compat/v3 proxy including rate limits (due 1736340000)
- Jordan: hardware retest checklist and vendor mapping doc (due 1736512800)
- Legal: embargo template (reply to thread) (target 1736476800)
Priya S.: We'll run a partner town hall (Q&A) during the preview start week. I'll schedule and post slides in the partner portal.
Mike L.: I'll open an eng-platform RFC for the protobuf/contract change and add a feature flag gate: 'schema_v4_enable'. Recommend GA only after marketplace integration badge is granted.
Anya K.: Also recommend we publish a CLI migration tool and a short video walkthrough for SIs. That helps reduce support load.
Jordan T.: Noted. Hardware partners that need firmware cycles should contact Jordan for extended timelines.
Eli R.: Looping infra cost modeling to ops-finance to set a hard limit on proxy runtime. If partners want longer than 90 days we should propose paid support.
Priya S.: Great. I'll consolidate this thread into the partner tracker and ping the partners list. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark: 
Mike L.: LGTM :thumbsup:
